ai_summary: An animated 3D blob visualization built with React Three Fiber, featuring custom Perlin noise shaders for organic vertex displacement. The component renders an icosahedron geometry with flowing, morphing animation controlled by time-based uniforms. Includes orbit controls for mouse-drag interaction and environment lighting setup for realistic rendering. Perfect as an eye-catching hero element or decorative background for modern web applications.
